newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan stocks extend gains in late trade.

text.p: Taiwan share prices extended their gains in late Thursday trade on strong buying in electronic and plastic shares, but brokers said they expected selling pressure as the index approaches 8,200 points.
With 20 minutes of trading to go, at 0340 GMT, the index had risen 119.51 points or 1.49 percent to 8,142.40.
Turnover was an active T$71 billion.
"The rise in electronics fuels upward momentum. But it's too early to say the market has finished with its consolidation," said Mike Tsai, an analyst of Grand Cathay Securities.
